title: Giovanni Borgherini and His Tutor
alt: Shown from the chest up against a black background, two men fill this horizontal portrait painting. To our left, a boy or young man in a floppy, denim-blue hat and an emerald-green tunic looks at us, gripping a paint brush, a quill pen, a flute and a compass in his fist. The man to our right, in a honey-yellow tunic, leans toward the boy almost in profile, holds up a brass-colored armillary sphere and points to it. A white scroll around the sphere's handle is inscribed “NON VALET. INGENIVM.NISI FACTA VALEBVNT.”

title: The Repentant Magdalen
alt: A young woman with pale skin and long chestnut-brown hair sits at a table in a darkened room, in a cream-colored, long-sleeved garment open at her neck. She rests her chin in her right hand as her left reaches for a skull placed on a thick book on the table. The scene is lit by a single candle mostly out of sight behind the skull. Shown in profile, she looks into a small mirror next to the skull, which reflects that object and the book.
